title: Result type with network failures
prompt: Create `src/pets.ts` that exports `type PetResult = { kind: "ok"; pet: Pet } | { kind: "not-found" } | { kind: "failed"; status: number } | { kind: "network-error" }` and `async function loadPet(client: Client<paths>, petId: number): Promise<PetResult>` (`Pet` is the generated `Pet` schema) using `GET /pets/{petId}`. `not-found` is a 404, `failed` is any other response that is not OK, and `network-error` is when the request cannot be sent at all (fetch rejects). `loadPet` never throws.
